NK có tỷ lệ chậm nặng cao; MQ nổi bật về: NK has a high severe-delay rate; MQ stands out for cancellations. These are descriptive comparisons; route, month and hour mix can change rankings.
ORD nhiều phút chậm nhất; LGA có rủi ro: ORD has the most positive delay minutes; LGA has high risk. Consider both volume and rates; compare airports with ≥10,000 flights. Scope: 11 months.
Kết quả arrival của chuyến khởi hành từ: Arrival outcomes for flights departing from each airport do not establish that the delay originated at that airport.
Danh sách top được xác định trên dữ liệu: Top lists are fixed from the 2015 baseline. Tooltips include scheduled-flight counts and arrival-eligible counts.
ORD → JFK cao về rủi ro, SFO → LAX lớn v: ORD → JFK stands out for risk; SFO → LAX for accumulated positive delay minutes. Volume and rates answer different questions.
17–21h: severe 8,49% so với 3,61% lúc 6–: At 17–21h, severe-delay risk is 8.49%, versus 3.61% at 06–11h. A gap remains within airline–airport–month comparisons; this is not causal evidence.
Late aircraft 39,84% và airline 32,20% P: Late aircraft accounts for 39.84% and airline for 32.20% of REPORTED CAUSE MINUTES. Recorded labels do not independently verify mechanisms.
Không trộn mẫu số: weather chiếm 4,95% p: Keep denominators separate: weather is 4.95% of reported cause minutes, while 54.35% of CANCELLED FLIGHTS carry the weather code.
Chưa có kết quả can thiệp trong nguồn. T: No intervention outcomes are available. Revalidate with recent data before a pilot; monitor severe delays, disruptions, p95 and cancellation guardrails.
Select routes and time windows with comparison groups. Monitor for 4–8 weeks after establishing a recent baseline; account for volume and operating mix.
Không gọi là cải thiện nếu mean giảm như: A lower mean is insufficient if cancellations rise, flight volume falls or records are excluded. Cost and passenger impacts cannot be quantified from these data.
